name: Tanker truck rear graphic, "C22 CUM TRUCK – BACK OFF! WE AINT HAULIN MILK!"
note: Snapshot of the rear of a fuel tanker (placard 1203, gasoline) with a custom decal. The decal shows a Yosemite Sam-style cartoon character in a feathered headdress holding two hatchets. The photographer and date are unknown, and the image circulates online as a meme. I did not run a web search, so no source confirms the photo's origin.
